Nodes Eligible to Form Ties for the Edges Correction

Source: R/net.mod.simnet.R
edges_correct_eligible.Rd

Returns a logical vector marking the nodes the edges correction should count, or NULL when the edges.correct.attr control is unset and every node counts.

Usage

edges_correct_eligible(dat, active)

Arguments

dat

Main netsim_dat object containing a networkDynamic object and other initialization information passed from netsim().

active

The active nodal attribute.

Value

A logical vector the same length as active, or NULL.
